name: [UPDATE] Project Web
desc:
(EARLY BETA TESTING)

Project Web is still in DEVELOPMENT so expect some bugs and glitches. I am working on getting them fixed. Game will be getting a story mode and be a fully complete game on release not just swinging.

Currently available:
- Tons of different suits
- Different swing styles
- Traffic system
- Web Wings (being worked on still)

If you enjoy the game, make sure to LIKE and FAVORITE to help support!

👍 We continue to UPDATE the game and add new content. This is only the beginning!
